newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Indonesian-linked stocks jump on Singapore bourse.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian-linked stocks jump on Singapore bourse.

text.p: Several Singapore stocks linked to Indonesian investors jumped sharply on Thursday afternoon.

By 0855 GMT, infrastructure company L&M Group was up 15 cents, or 11 percent, to Singapore $1.52, while United Pulp & Paper was up 17 cents, or 14 percent at S$1.35 and ABR Holdings was up 19 cents at S$1.23.
Prominent Indonesian investors own significant chunks of all three companies.
Dealers had no immediate explanation for the move.
One dealer said the rise might be linked to the general election in Indonesia.

"It is clear Golkar is going to win the election, and all these companies have been associated with the figures in the government," he said in reference to the party which has ruled Indonesia for more than 30 years.
